text:
Sam (PM): Heads up — need a rollout plan for the 'fastfail_v2' feature. Customer Fern asked for per-tenant opt-in, staged regions, and a strict fallback policy. Can we sketch options? TL;DR: feature flags granularity, canary %, A/B for perf vs quality.
Jordana (ENG): We can expose a flag hierarchy: global -> region -> tenant. Default off, tenant opt-in behind Dedicated. Per-tenant routing work is non-trivial; estimate ~2 weeks to add flag scope + API.
Kevin (SRE): SRE constraints — per-tenant spikes are risky. We should require token quotas + circuit breaker + 5m rolling-avg alarms before enabling opt-in. Proposed staging: 1% global -> 5% region -> 20% region over 24h windows with soak checks.
Tara (RESEARCH): For the A/B piece we need sample-size calc and primary/secondary metrics. Primary: latency P95; secondary: rerank accuracy / hallucination rate. Recommend min 7 days per cohort for stable signals.
Sam (PM): Also customer wants auto-fallback to a cheaper quantized model on surge. Is automated fallback feasible (routing policy based on SLOs)?
Jordana (ENG): Feasible. Implement routing policy with triggers: if p95_latency > threshold OR queue_depth > N, route to fallback model variant. Add flag 'fallback_on_surge' to enable/disable per-tenant.
Kevin (SRE): Ops playbook draft: quick kill = flip tenant flag to off + run emergency fallback; if auto-fallback misbehaves, run deploy-bot rollback. Need a canary kill-switch in Console with one-click. Also require throttles so capacity doesn't blow budgets.
deploy-bot: deploy preview for canary rollout config:
```
flags:
  name: fastfail_v2
  scope: [global, region, tenant]
steps:
  - percent: 1
    scope: global
    duration: 2h
  - percent: 10
    scope: region
    duration: 12h
  - tenant_opt_in: true
fallbacks:
  - model_variant: quant-4
    trigger: p95_latency > 800ms OR queue_depth > 200
```
Tara (RESEARCH): Add a qualitative eval hook: sample prompts from top-10 customers, monitor hallucination/regression alerts tied to evals. If quality delta > X, auto-halt rollout.
Sam (PM): Action items: Jordana — implement flag API + routing policy (ETA 10d). Kevin — run threshold sims and propose alarm thresholds + kill-switch UX (ETA 4d). Tara — AB sample-size + eval set and regression gates (ETA 3d). I'll sync with Fern for opt-in timeline. :thumbsup:
